subject: science

concepts.title: Average Speed
concepts.definition: The rate of total distance covered by an object over a specific duration of time.
concepts.key_idea: Total path length divided by total time.
question_patterns: calculate the average speed
what is the average speed of the object
find average speed given distance and time
how much is the average speed
find the required value in a average speed problem

solution_steps.explain: average speed is total distance travelled per unit time interval
ensure distance and time units are compatible so the resulting speed has correct units (e.g. m/s or km/h)
solution_steps.compute: avg_speed = total_distance / time_interval  # verify units match

solution_steps.action: verify the result is positive and reasonable
solution_steps.explain: average speed must be non-negative and should not exceed plausible physical limits for the object in question

concepts.title: Average Velocity
concepts.definition: The ratio of the net change in position (displacement) of an object to the total time taken for that change.
question_patterns: calculate the average velocity
what is the average velocity
find the average velocity of the object
how much is the average velocity
compute the answer step by step for average velocity

solution_steps.explain: average velocity is the net change in position over the time interval
the sign of avg_velocity indicates direction: positive means motion along the chosen positive axis, negative means motion in the opposite direction

solution_steps.action: verify magnitude does not exceed average speed
solution_steps.explain: since displacement magnitude is at most equal to total distance, the magnitude of average velocity cannot exceed the average speed

concepts.title: Average Acceleration
concepts.definition: The rate at which an object's velocity changes over a given time interval.
concepts.key_idea: Change in velocity divided by time.
question_patterns: calculate the average acceleration
what is the average acceleration
find the acceleration of the vehicle
how much does the velocity change per second
calculate average acceleration for the given values

solution_steps.explain: find the difference between final and initial velocity
acceleration is the rate of change of velocity

solution_steps.action: verify sign and reasonableness of acceleration
solution_steps.explain: a positive acceleration means the object is speeding up along the chosen axis, while a negative value means it is slowing down or accelerating in the opposite direction

concepts.title: Kinematic Equation: Final Velocity
concepts.definition: Relates final velocity to initial velocity, constant acceleration, and time.
concepts.key_idea: Velocity at time t with constant acceleration.
question_patterns: find the final velocity
what will be the velocity after time t
calculate velocity using acceleration
how fast is the object moving after t seconds
work out the value using kinematic equation: final velocity

solution_steps.explain: calculate the total change in velocity
final velocity is initial plus the change

solution_steps.action: verify final velocity is physically consistent
solution_steps.explain: check that the computed final velocity has the correct sign and magnitude consistent with the direction of acceleration and the initial velocity

concepts.title: Kinematic Equation: Displacement
concepts.definition: Calculates the total displacement using initial velocity, time, and constant acceleration.
question_patterns: calculate the distance travelled
what is the displacement after time t
find the position change
how far does the object travel
find the required value in a kinematic equation: displacement problem

solution_steps.explain: total displacement is the sum of both parts

concepts.title: Kinematic Equation: Velocity-Displacement
concepts.definition: Relates final velocity, initial velocity, acceleration, and displacement without needing time.
concepts.key_idea: Velocity squared relation for constant acceleration.
question_patterns: find final velocity given displacement
calculate the stopping distance
what is the velocity after distance s
find initial velocity using displacement
calculate kinematic equation: velocity-displacement for the given values

solution_steps.explain: prepare values for the kinematic relation
add the squared speed and the acceleration-displacement term, then take the square root
